verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Honeybadger's own AI drafting a code fix or opening a pull request. Its AI features cover natural-language search and an MCP server that lets external assistants investigate errors. The webhook bearer-token support for Cursor Automations hands fix work to a third-party tool, and the GitHub/GitLab integration exports issues, not pull requests. All of these are adjacent features or building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's AI can draft a code fix for an error and open a pull request against my repo for human review
